text:
mira (AE): MeridianBank POC kickoff — they want drop-in swap from CompetitorY. Demo Wed, POC by EOW. Needs: session stickiness, minimal client changes, rerank parity, security docs.
owen - solutions: Can we do a tiny proxy to map their session semantics to Redwood conversation API?
harper (SE): Yes. Proxy maps `X-Session-Id` -> `conversation_id`, injects original system prompt on first call, mirrors history ordering (system, assistant, user). Example CompetitorY flow: `POST /session/create` + `POST /session/message`.
jordan (sales-eng): Need deterministic continuation for reranker. Can we pin model_revision + fixed sampling seed?
harper (SE): Yes — pin model_revision for POC and pass sampler seed. We'll enable prefix_cache for first 2 turns.
security-eng: Meridian needs KMS customer-managed, DPA, SOC2. We can provide docs under NDA in 48-72h. For hosted we can preserve session via proxy; on-prem session store requires Private deployment.
infra-oncall: Rate-limit differences: proxy can emulate per-session QPS and translate headers (`X-Remaining-Calls` -> `X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining`). Don't expose internal TTLs.
devops-bot: Workspace `meridian-poc-2026` created, access granted to harper, owen, mira.
mira (AE): Action items: @harper run parity harness (10 canonical prompts) by Tue; @owen prepare cost comparison (hosted vs Dedicated) by Tue; @security-eng send sec questionnaire link. Demo Wed 2pm ET.
owen - solutions: I'll scaffold a Node proxy example and push to git.redwood/meridian-poc-proxy.
mira (AE): If parity OK, propose 30-day Dedicated pilot. Updating legal and PS. :white_check_mark:
